issues.text: Step 3 recommends a named constant for 'each price', while the pinned C# reference advises against that for prices: const.md:13 "Don't create a constant to represent information that you expect to change over time. For example, don't use a constant field to store the price of a service". Behaviour is unchanged (claim 10 verified), but a junior may take away 'prices go in const' without the condition.
issues.fix: Keep 'name' without prescribing a constant for prices, e.g. "Give `2000000` and each price a name that says what it is. A named value holding the same number changes no result." (and in claim 10 drop 'const' or limit it to this one method).
issues.quote: Give `2000000` and each price a name that says what it is. A named constant with the same value changes no result.
